route: Resveratrol / BUB1B transcript screen in A549 cells
decision: Do not use this evidence to support BUBR1 restoration. Retain resveratrol's separate functional muscle evidence as a reserve; this source establishes no MVA benefit or ordinary-use harm.

experiment.processing: MAS5.0, as stated in GEO sample metadata

analysis.summary: All three treated-array signals are 16.5% to 20.4% below one vehicle-control signal; no valid inferential test is available with a single control.
not_measured: MVA1 cells or the nominated patient variants
